definition.calendar: NYSE US equity trading calendar; exchange holidays skipped; DST by America/New_York; early close uses official last regular-session bar.
definition.multiple_signal_policy: CO_EMIT_ALL_MATCHES_IN_PRECEDENCE_ORDER; precedence is ordering, not suppression.
definition.purpose: Classify ORCL directional setups from prior-session option GEX capital-type structure and issue notification-only paper plans; v1.1 adds production feature-tier confirmation using ORCL and QQQ GEX_Features.
definition.rationale: Ticker-specific GEX rules selected from full-period research; see strategy.md for rule-level rationale.
definition.source_refresh_gate: At/after 07:30 America/New_York on current US trading session D1: latest complete GEX ObservationDate must equal previous US trading session D0; exactly one BC/BP/SC/SP row; non-null GEXDelta/Close/VWAP; 60 prior complete observations; canonical source revision stable for this heartbeat. Otherwise NOT_READY and create nothing. Additionally require D0 rows from StockDB_US.Analysis.GEX_Features for ORCL and QQQ with all tier variables non-null; otherwise NOT_READY.

pushover.recipient: Configured production Pushover user key from secrets; never embedded in packet

production_policy.change_control: Any base trigger, feature-tier predicate, direction, entry/exit rule, or notification policy change requires a new version.

out_of_sample_window.reason: Feature-tier predicates were selected after screening the available historical sample; exact v1.1 predicates are now frozen for forward production validation.

signal_definitions.confidence_method: Fixed research confidence label based on historical sample size, directional consistency and rule stability; not recalculated live.
signal_definitions.definition: Bullish GEX composition fails to keep ORCL above its observation-day VWAP; the failure historically precedes additional downside. Feature-confirmed HIGH tier.
